content.text:
For consultants, choosing a CRM typically comes down to whether you need a lightweight tool for contact tracking, a full pipeline management platform, or an all-in-one suite that handles proposals, invoicing, and contracts.

---

### 1. Simple & Relationship-Centric CRMs

#### **Less Annoying CRM**
*Best for: Solo consultants who want simple, transparent pricing with no feature bloating.*
* **Pricing:** Flat rate of **$15 per user/month** (no annual commitment required).
* **What you get:** Contact management, task tracking, pipeline tracking, calendar sync, and phone customer support.
* **Source:** [Less Annoying CRM Official Pricing](https://www.lessannoyingcrm.com/pricing)

#### **Capsule CRM**
*Best for: Independent consultants and small agencies needing project tracking alongside contact records.*
* **Pricing:** 
  * **Free Plan:** $0 for up to 2 users (capped at 250 contacts).
  * **Paid Tiers:** **$18–$72 per user/month** billed annually (or **$21–$75 per user/month** month-to-month).
* **What you get:** Contact management, project delivery boards (post-sale work), sales pipelines, and AI content assists on higher tiers.
* **Source:** [Capsule CRM Official Pricing](https://capsulecrm.com/pricing/)

#### **Copper CRM**
*Best for: Consultants working strictly within Google Workspace (Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive).*
* **Pricing:** **$9–$99 per user/month** billed annually (or **$12–$134 per user/month** billed monthly).
* **What you get:** Native Gmail sidebar, contact scraping, deal tracking, workflow automations, and Google Drive attachments.
* **Source:** [Copper CRM Pricing](https://www.copper.com/pricing)

---

### 2. Pipeline & Deal-Focused CRMs

#### **Pipedrive**
*Best for: Consultants with an active outbound sales strategy who need visual deal tracking.*
* **Pricing:** **$14–$79 per user/month** billed annually (or **$24–$99 per user/month** billed monthly) across Lite, Growth, Premium, and Ultimate tiers.
* **What you get:** Kanban pipelines, activity reminders, meeting scheduling, email tracking, and AI sales tools.
* **Source:** [Pipedrive CRM Pricing Plans](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/pricing)

#### **Zoho CRM**
*Best for: Growing consulting practices that need customization, third-party integrations, and scalability at a lower price point.*
* **Pricing:** 
  * **Free Plan:** $0 for up to 3 users.
  * **Paid Tiers:** **$14–$52 per user/month** billed annually (or **$20–$65 per user/month** billed monthly).
* **What you get:** Deal tracking, lead scoring, workflow automation, and Zia AI assistance on Enterprise and higher plans.
* **Source:** [Zoho CRM Pricing & Editions](https://www.zoho.com/crm/pricing.html)

---

### 3. All-in-One Freelancer & Client Management Platforms

#### **Bonsai**
*Best for: Solo consultants who need CRM combined with contracts, time-tracking, proposals, and invoicing.*
* **Pricing:** **$9–$49 per user/month** billed annually (or **$15–$59 per user/month** billed monthly) across Basic, Essentials, Premium, and Elite tiers.
* **What you get:** Client portal, proposal and agreement builders, automated billing, scheduling, and project expense management.
* **Source:** [Bonsai Pricing](https://www.hellobonsai.com/pricing)

#### **HoneyBook**
*Best for: Service providers and consultants needing end-to-end client booking, contracts, questionnaires, and payment processing.*
* **Pricing:** **$19–$79 per month** billed annually (or **$36–$129 per month** billed monthly).
* **What you get:** Interactive client proposals, integrated payment processing, contract e-signatures, automations, and client communications.
* **Source:** [HoneyBook Pricing & Plans](https://www.honeybook.com/pricing)

---

### 4. Marketing & Ecosystem Platforms

#### **HubSpot CRM**
*Best for: Inbound-driven consulting firms that rely heavily on content, forms, and marketing automation.*
* **Pricing:**
  * **Free CRM:** $0 for basic contact, lead, and deal management.
  * **Starter Tier:** **$15–$20 per user/month** (promotional pricing starts as low as **$7–$12 per user/month**).
  * **Professional Tiers:** Scales to **$800–$890 per month** (plus onboarding fees) for advanced marketing automation.
* **What you get:** Email marketing, live chat, meeting scheduler, deal tracking, and marketing attribution.
* **Source:** [HubSpot Customer Platform Pricing](https://www.hubspot.com/pricing)

---

### Summary Comparison Table

| CRM Platform | Annual Billing Range (per user) | Monthly Billing Range (per user) | Primary Consultant Use Case |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Less Annoying CRM** | Flat $15/user/month | Flat $15/user/month | Pure, simple contact and task management |
| **Bonsai** | $9–$49/user/month | $15–$59/user/month | Proposals, contracts, invoicing & CRM |
| **Copper** | $9–$99/user/month | $12–$134/user/month | Deep Google Workspace integration |
| **Zoho CRM** | $0 (Free) or $14–$52/user/month | $20–$65/user/month | Deep customization & sales workflows |
| **Pipedrive** | $14–$79/user/month | $24–$99/user/month | Visual pipeline and deal velocity |
| **Capsule CRM** | $0 (Free) or $18–$72/user/month | $21–$75/user/month | Lightweight contact & project boards |
| **HoneyBook** | $19–$79/month *(flat)* | $36–$129/month *(flat)* | Client onboarding, booking & billing |
| **HubSpot CRM** | $0 (Free) or $15–$20/seat/month *(Starter)* | $20/seat/month | Inbound marketing & lead generation |
